strings.en: Tiffany

strings.zh: 你也喜欢皮皮吗？{SCROLL}皮皮非常可爱吧。{SCROLL}我们好像很合得来啊！{NEWLINE}我们做个朋友怎么样？{CLEAR}方便的话把你的电话号码{CLEAR}告诉给我好吗？{SCROLL}我们聊些关于皮皮的话题吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You like Clefairy, too? Clefairy are so{NEWLINE}cute, aren’t they?{SCROLL}We really seem to hit it off! Why don’t{NEWLINE}we be friends?{SCROLL}If it’s OK, could you give{NEWLINE}me your phone number?{CLEAR}Let’s talk about Clefairy! {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0669/1; modernised from US 0669#1 | RV072: omission: restored 'we get along' / 'be friends' clauses; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 我的小皮皮{NEWLINE}非常可爱吧。
strings.en: Isn’t my Clefairy super adorable?

strings.zh: 好遗憾啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}不过你要还想聊关于{NEWLINE}皮皮的话题的话,{CLEAR}就再来找我吧！
strings.en: Aww... Oh well. Look for me if you want{NEWLINE}to talk about Clefairy.

strings.zh: 如果你方便的话{NEWLINE}能把电话号码告诉我吗？{SCROLL}聊聊关于皮皮的话题吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Won’t you give me your number?{NEWLINE}Let’s talk about Clefairy! {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 你来了啊！{NEWLINE}这个送给你,{CLEAR}皮皮玩偶！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh, there you are! Here,{NEWLINE}this is for you. A Poké Doll!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我说⋯⋯{NEWLINE}难道找我聊天很困难吗？{SCROLL}虽然打电话也可以,{NEWLINE}不过你都来这么近了,{CLEAR}干嘛不直接找我聊啊。
strings.en: Um... Well...{NEWLINE}Is it that difficult to talk to me?{SCROLL}I mean, by phone is all right, but if{NEWLINE}we’re this close, you don’t have to{CLEAR}stay away.{CLEAR}You can just come talk to me.

strings.zh: 啊,{VAR:010E:4},不好了！{NEWLINE}我的皮皮⋯⋯{CLEAR}哎？{CLEAR}你是{VAR:0103:0}？{SCROLL}抱、抱歉！{NEWLINE}刚才拨太快,打错了！{SCROLL}不好意思啊,再见！
strings.en: {VAR:010E:4}, it’s awful! My{NEWLINE}Clefairy... Huh? This is {VAR:0103:0}?{SCROLL}S-sorry! I dialed too fast{NEWLINE}and got the wrong number!{SCROLL}So sorry! Bye!

strings.zh: 啊,{VAR:010E:4},不好了！{NEWLINE}我的皮皮⋯⋯{CLEAR}哎？{CLEAR}你是{VAR:0103:0}？{SCROLL}抱、抱歉！{NEWLINE}刚才拨太快,打错了！{SCROLL}不好意思啊,再见！
strings.en: {VAR:010E:4}, it’s awful! My{NEWLINE}Clefairy... Huh? This is {VAR:0103:0}?{SCROLL}S-sorry! I dialed too fast{NEWLINE}and got the wrong number!{SCROLL}So sorry! Bye!

strings.zh: 你是不是觉得{NEWLINE}我的{VAR:0100:10}很可爱啊？{SCROLL}我们一直睡在一起,{NEWLINE}软绵绵的,好暖和！{SCROLL}还有,{NEWLINE}前段时间我和{VAR:0100:11}{CLEAR}大战了一场⋯⋯{SCROLL}结果我的小皮皮{NEWLINE}差一点就挂掉了！{SCROLL}太过分了！{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}什么的,人家最讨厌了！{SCROLL}这次就聊这些了,拜拜！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10}’s adorable, don’t you{NEWLINE}think so?{SCROLL}We always sleep together--it’s so{NEWLINE}fluffy and warm!{SCROLL}Oh, and a while ago we had a big battle{NEWLINE}with a {VAR:0100:11}...{SCROLL}My Clefairy nearly croaked! That was so{NEWLINE}mean! I just hate {VAR:0100:11}!{SCROLL}That’s all for now. Bye-bye!
strings.notes: US 0669/9; modernised from US 0669#9 | tone review: 挂掉 is slang for dying: 'nearly croaked' (D-0627) | RV072: omission: restored 'that was so mean' and 'that's all for now'

strings.zh: 你是不是觉得{NEWLINE}我的{VAR:0100:10}很可爱啊？{SCROLL}我们一直睡在一起,{NEWLINE}软绵绵的,好暖和！{SCROLL}还有,{NEWLINE}前段时间我和{VAR:0100:11}{CLEAR}大战了一场⋯⋯{SCROLL}结果小皮皮畏战了,{NEWLINE}一溜烟逃了！{SCROLL}今后我一定要{NEWLINE}好好保护我的小皮皮,{SCROLL}再见！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10}’s adorable, don’t you{NEWLINE}think so?{SCROLL}We always sleep together--it’s so{NEWLINE}fluffy and warm!{SCROLL}Oh, and a while ago we had a big battle{NEWLINE}with a {VAR:0100:11}...{SCROLL}My Clefairy got scared of battling and{NEWLINE}ran off like a shot!{SCROLL}From now on, I’ll protect my Clefairy{NEWLINE}properly. Bye!
strings.notes: US 0669/10; modernised from US 0669#10 | RV072: meaning: only Clefairy fled; future promise to protect (D-1898)

strings.zh: 虽然很唐突⋯⋯{NEWLINE}不过我想来一场精灵对战。{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}和小皮皮一起等你。
strings.en: I know this might surprise you, but{NEWLINE}would you like to battle?{SCROLL}I’ll be waiting with Clefairy on{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}.

strings.zh: 你怎么了？怎么还没来？{SCROLL}小皮皮都已经{NEWLINE}等得睡过去了。{CLEAR}不知道对战的时候会不会醒⋯⋯{SCROLL}我们在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}快来啊！
strings.en: What’s wrong? Why aren’t you here yet?{SCROLL}Clefairy got so tired of waiting that it{NEWLINE}fell asleep.{SCROLL}I don’t know if it’ll wake up for our{NEWLINE}battle...{SCROLL}We’re on {VAR:0104:3}, so hurry!
strings.notes: US 0669/12; modernised from US 0669#12 | RV072: meaning: worry is whether Clefairy wakes for the battle

strings.zh: 人家最喜欢把小皮皮{NEWLINE}打扮得漂漂亮亮的了！
strings.en: I just love making my Clefairy look all{NEWLINE}pretty!
strings.notes: US 0669/13; modernised from US 0669#13 | RV072: omission: 漂漂亮亮 restored

strings.zh: 之前我在满金市百货商店{NEWLINE}看到一个非常非常可爱的{CLEAR}皮皮玩偶。{CLEAR}我想把它送给你,{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}有空了就来拿吧。
strings.en: I saw a super-cute Poké Doll at the{NEWLINE}Goldenrod Dept. Store the other{CLEAR}day. I want to give it to you!{SCROLL}I’m at {VAR:0104:3}.{NEWLINE}Come get it when you’re free.

strings.zh: 你怎么了？怎么还没来？{NEWLINE}皮皮玩偶可是很可爱的！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}快点来吧！
strings.en: What’s wrong? Can’t you visit?{SCROLL}This Poké Doll is so cute, too!{NEWLINE}Please hurry to {VAR:0104:3}!
